items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: And I think a clarinet player you called Big Eye Louie. That's all I knew, Big Eye Louie.

ctx.x: Walter DeCoult. Well, I knew him. He was a piano at that time.
And I think a clarinet player you called Big Eye Louie. That's all I knew, Big Eye Louie.

I never didn't know his other name. Some people called him Louie Nelson too. His real name was Deleal though, Louie Deleal, but his father had called him Louie Nelson for some reason. I think the big guy told me his father had worked with some people called Nelson when he was a boy. A lot of people just called him Nelson then. But that's one reason Bunker always called Louie Nelson. The trombone is called Dr. Nelson's son because of the other big guy. His name was Well, I never didn't know much about him. In…
